params.prompt: A real aerial photograph taken from exactly the viewpoint of the first attached image: a drone high over farmland looking across the whole small Pacific Northwest town spread out below (its street grid, rooftops, tree-lined streets, fairgrounds, open fields and dark evergreen forest beyond, rolling foothills) to Mount Rainier standing dead centre on the horizon, huge; the second attached image shows the real photographic look of the mountain's north face. The last twenty minutes before sunset in late summer: low warm sunlight from the right raking across the rooftops and fields with long shadows, the mountain's glaciers glowing pink and gold, the sky clear and deepening to blue, the air perfectly clear, no haze, no fog, no blur, every rooftop sharp. Photoreal, full-frame camera, 35 mm, f/8, like a high-quality photograph, never a 3D render or a map; no text of any kind, no titles, no overlays, no logos, no watermark, no people.
